themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints skyrocketed to 8 THIS WEEK compared to a baseline average of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks — a 6,300% spike (z-score: 23.81) suggesting a coordinated campaign or enforcement gap in CD 314.
evidence: 8 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
z-score of 23.81 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
reporting_angles: Is there a new poster/advertiser flooding the district with flyers or signage? Who and where are complaints concentrated?
Are SanDep or Parks enforcement crews understaffed or diverted, allowing postings to accumulate?

themes_detail.label: Graffiti Surge in Midwood
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints surged to 12 THIS WEEK, up 336% from a baseline of 2.8 per week (z-score: 3.97), signaling either a new gang or artist activity or a lapse in removal services across the district.
evidence: 12 graffiti complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Temporally clustered with illegal posting spike, suggesting coordinated activity or enforcement gap
reporting_angles: Are specific neighborhoods or blocks being targeted? Is this a territorial marker or tag campaign?
What is the SanDep graffiti removal backlog, and has the removal crew been reduced or redeployed?

themes_detail.label: Construction Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints jumped to 55 LAST WEEK, up 304% from an 8-week baseline of 13.6 per week (z-score: 9.56), coinciding with 316 total DOB permits filed in the last 90 days, including 31 new buildings and 9 full demolitions.
evidence: 55 construction/plumbing complaints LAST WEEK vs. 13.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
316 DOB permits filed in last 90 days: 236 alterations, 31 new buildings, 9 full demolitions
Five active ULURP/rezoning proposals in public review (Ditmas Park West, Beverley Square West, three avenue rezonings)
reporting_angles: Which new construction projects (if any) are generating the most complaints? Are they complying with noise and dust regulations?
Are the historic district rezonings (Ditmas Park West, Beverley Square West) triggering resident concerns about project scope and community impact?

themes_detail.label: Encampment Reports Rise
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints rose to 6 LAST WEEK, up 1,100% from a baseline of 0.5 per week (z-score: 5.5), marking an emerging homelessness or street-use issue in CD 314 requiring investigation.
evidence: 6 encampment complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Temporally concurrent with spike in non-emergency police matters (6 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.6 baseline, +129%)
reporting_angles: Where are the encampments concentrated (specific intersections, parks, transit corridors)? Are they permanent or transient?
What services or support do unhoused people in these encampments have access to? Are social workers or outreach teams engaged?

themes_detail.label: Police Matter Complaints Elevated
themes_detail.summary: Non-emergency police complaints rose to 6 LAST WEEK, up 129% from an 8-week baseline of 2.6 per week (z-score: 4.85), correlating with the encampment spike and suggesting emerging public safety or quality-of-life friction.
evidence: 6 non-emergency police complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Concurrent with 1,100% jump in encampment complaints, suggesting related underlying issue
reporting_angles: What types of police matters are residents calling about (disorder, loitering, conflict)? Is there a geographic hotspot?
Are NYPD or community safety teams deployed differently in response to encampment or disorder activity?
